re_equipmentnumbers.description: Draft-API-owned JSON array of exact selected equipment snapshot numbers. Null means all equipment (legacy behavior). An explicit nonempty unique subset must agree with re_quantity.

deployment: Publish the optional column before deploying either assembly or the app.
Deploy Drafts and pricing together, retaining existing snapshot guards, locks and all-column images.
Never backfill explicit subsets on historical packages. Null retains the global equipment plus additional-equipment pricing behavior.
Test as an estimator: save, reopen, clone, 4/3/5 package quantities, invalid subsets, currency/rates and export snapshot.
Export snapshots include all package attributes and freeze assignments and calculated totals. Workbook rendering must honor per-package re_quantity.
